guards.issue: Closed 2026-07-29 (round 7): `CardCmd.upgrade(hooks, card)` exists (cmds.py) and is CardCmd.cs:265-290's per-card body: the verb sits inside `if (!IsEnding)` and skips any card whose `IsUpgradable` is false, i.e. `CurrentUpgradeLevel < MaxUpgradeLevel` (CardModel.cs:785-789). 35 of the 203 ported cards are at MaxUpgradeLevel 0 (18 Curse, 14 Status, 3 Quest), and C# THROWS if CurrentUpgradeLevel is ever set above MaxUpgradeLevel (CardModel.cs:773-776) -- so the bare `card.upgrade()` was producing a state the source treats as impossible, and one conformance compares against the save as an (id, upgrade_level) pair. bone_tea.py loops the opening hand through it, passing `self.hooks` so the IsEnding guard is live. EXECUTED: a hand of [strike, dazed, burn] comes out at [1, 0, 0] where it used to be [1, 1, 1].  Pinned by test/test_procure_and_upgrade_verbs.py.  NOT CLOSED: the cluster this entry named is now empty except for the two `_eggs.py` sites, which its own text records as DORMANT (the egg relics filter to Attack/Skill/Power, and every level-0 card is Curse/Status/Quest) and burning_sticks/dusty_tome, which are separate records. REACHABILITY (LIVE, executed -- py audit/tools/relic_probes.py batch2): a hand of [strike, dazed, burn] comes out at upgrade_level [1, 1, 1] where C# gives [1, 0, 0]. An executed census puts 35 of 203 ported cards at max_upgrade_level 0 (18 Curse, 14 Status, 3 Quest), and statuses reach the opening hand routinely -- relic/blessed_antler, audited in this very batch, shuffles three Dazed into the turn-1 draw pile, and Bone Tea fires post-draw. guards.what: N1: `combats_left` is never reset at a combat boundary and C# never resets it either
guards.rationale: Bone Tea is a single-charge, whole-RUN relic: `_combatsLeft = 1` is a field initialiser (BoneTea.cs:7) with no BeforeCombatStart or AfterCombatEnd override anywhere in the file, and the sim mirrors that with a constructor default (bone_tea.py:25). Verified against the pool-wide scan (py audit/tools/relic_probes.py sweep-reset), which flags bone_tea as never-reset but correctly reports 'C# resets: NONE' -- the marker that separates a per-run counter from the relic/belt_buckle defect, where C# resets in three places and the sim in none.

The `player != base.Owner` / `shuffler == base.Owner` / `cardPlay.Card.Owner != base.Owner` family is the multiplayer per-player filter on a hook the game dispatches for every player. The sim is single-player by construction (one RunState, one PlayerCombatState), so the filter is structurally satisfied. Multiplayer-only paths are out of scope under the shared contract.
